verdict.rationale: WooCommerce's REST API is clearly versioned: endpoints sit under the /wp-json/wc/v3/ prefix, and prior v1/v2 and legacy versions are kept as separate documented namespaces. The same source states that no deprecation-timeline policy is published, so only half of the story is delivered. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy with timelines or sunset guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration of version stability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: all endpoints are versioned under the /wp-json/wc/v3/ prefix (e.g. GET /wp-json/wc/v3/products), with prior versions (v1/v2, legacy) retained as separate documented namespaces
